slug: 2026-02-23 Zambia and Mozambique launch fibre-optic interconnector at Chanida–Cassacatiza border

facts.fact: Zambia's Minister of Technology and Science said at the commissioning ceremony that the Chanida-Cassacatiza cross-border fibre interconnector, built by Bayobab Zambia and Vodacom, was launched and links Zambia's national backbone to Mozambique's submarine cable network; the document gives no date other than its published date, 2026-02-23.

Zambia's Minister of Technology and Science, Felix Mutati, said at the Chanida-Cassacatiza commissioning that Zambia now has fibre links to eight neighbouring countries (added by the parent from the same document).
facts.system: fibre links to eight neighbouring countries

note: Eight-neighbour fibre claim names no other links and no counts of routes carrying international traffic, so it is not recorded as a two or independent fact; no access statement.
